notConnectedMessage: Please connect to Soulbits Engine or Soulbits Cloud first from the Connection Setup screen.
forceFullResyncMessage:
This will re-sync ALL data between this device and the backend Engine Instance. This can take a while and may use significant bandwidth.

Use this only if you suspect data is out of sync.
heroSubtextConnected: Your data is in sync with the backend
heroSubtextNotPaired: Pair your device to get started
heroSubtextCloudConnected: Your data is in sync with the cloud
heroSubtextCloudPreparing: Your cloud session is being prepared…
heroSubtextServerUpdateRequired: Update your Soulbits Engine to resume syncing
cloudSessionNotActive: Your cloud session is not active. Open Connection Manager to check the status.
cloudDisconnectedWarning: Cloud connection lost. Attempting to reconnect...
cloudReconnectingInfo: Auto-reconnect in progress. The cloud connection will be restored automatically.
notPairedWarning: Not paired with Soulbits Engine. Go to Connection Setup to pair your device.
reconnectingInfo: Auto-reconnect in progress. The connection will be restored automatically.
serverUpdateRequiredWarning: Soulbits Engine must be updated before syncing can continue. Please update Soulbits Engine to the latest version — this device will reconnect and resume syncing automatically once the update is done.
estimateConfirmLimitHint: Ask before syncing when the download is larger than this.
resetCloudDataCardDescription: Permanently deletes ALL soulbits-engine data in the cloud: characters, memories, chats, and autonomy state. Your data on this device is NOT deleted.
resetCloudDataMessage: This permanently deletes ALL soulbits-engine data in the cloud — characters, memories, chats, and autonomy state. Your data on this device is NOT deleted and can be re-uploaded afterwards. Once started, deletion cannot be undone or stopped.
resetCloudDataProgressHint: This may take a few minutes. You can leave this screen — we'll keep you updated.
resetCloudDataSuccessMessage: Your cloud data was deleted. The app will reconnect and run a FULL re-sync of your local data automatically. You can also start the full re-sync from here.
purgeSuccessResyncing: Cloud data deleted — re-syncing your data now.
purgeInProgressOtherDevice: Cloud data is being reset on another device. Try again once it completes.
resetCloudDataFailedUnknown: Cloud data deletion didn't finish. Your data may not be fully deleted. You can safely retry.
resetCloudDataDeadline: Still deleting… this is taking longer than expected. Check back later — connecting stays paused until it finishes.
purgeBannerTitle: Your cloud data is being deleted
purgeBannerBody: Connecting is paused until the deletion finishes.
